Document operations failing after recent changes

I'm encountering several issues with document operations that seem to have broken recently. The problems appear to be related to header/footer handling, document saving, and numbering part access.

```python

from docx.parts.document import DocumentPart

# Create a document and try basic operations
doc = Document()

# Try to save the document
doc.save('test.docx')  # This fails

# Try to access numbering part
```
